definitions.explanation: The act of polishing or cleaning something until it shines; mostly met in compounds such as {歯磨|はみが}き and {靴磨|くつみが}き.
Further improvement of a skill or quality that is already good, in {磨|みが}きをかける and {磨|みが}きがかかる.

examples.english: To send the car to be polished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧な{磨|みが}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{磨|みが}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Her acting has become more polished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さらに{磨|みが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけたい。
examples.english: I want to study abroad to refine my English pronunciation further.

notes:
The noun of ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish). On its own, sense 2 is the commoner use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{磨|みが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to polish, to hone (a skill)
- {磨|みが}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to become more polished
- ⟦{歯磨|はみが}き→歯磨き：03137_hamigaki⟧: toothbrushing; toothpaste
- ⟦{靴磨|くつみが}き→靴磨き：27852_kutsumigaki⟧: shoe shining
